name: Agaram 2.5B Chat
description: Chat with Agaram 2.5B, a Tamil-English model from scratch

paragraphs: A chat demo for murai-labs/agaram-2.5b-instruct, a Tamil–English language model trained from scratch by Murai Labs (technical report: arXiv:2610.18420). It uses the settings of every reported chat result: no system prompt, greedy decoding, up to 512 new tokens. When a message contains one of a short list of distress phrases, the demo does not run the model and shows a fixed reply with crisis helplines instead.

This is a research model: expect wrong facts, and do not use its answers as medical, legal, financial or crisis advice. During the preview, conversations are stored only for visitors who tick the consent box, to evaluate and train future versions of Agaram (private dataset, not published; self-harm messages are never stored). The licence above covers this demo's code; see the model card for the model weights.
